answer: An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 4 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Since the island hash is stored at intake, the jetty graph groups the endorsements and the zephyr audit publishes the collapse. An operator copying one text across 115 aliases therefore forfeits for 115 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
